levers.name: Iran / oil
levers.watch: Middle East escalation is the transmission channel to rate-cut repricing, with oil as the lever. A rapid CL=F spike would widen breakevens and reprice fed-funds futures, reversing the conditions that have supported the semis recovery.
levers.watch_zh: 中东局势升级是向降息重定价传导的通道，石油是核心杠杆。CL=F快速飙升将扩大盈亏平衡通胀预期并重定价联邦基金期货，逆转支撑半导体复苏的现有条件。

levers.name: China / tariffs
levers.watch: US-China trade friction is the policy channel most directly tied to semis supply-chain margins: an escalation in tariffs or export controls would compress the margins priced into the current recovery.
levers.watch_zh: 中美贸易摩擦是与半导体供应链利润率关联最直接的政策渠道：关税或出口管制的任何升级，都会压缩已计入当前复苏预期的利润率。

framing: Conditions under which violent reversals are more likely — not intent, not timing.
framing_zh: 衡量剧烈反转更可能发生的条件——不是意图，也不是时点。
